name: node-js-demo-app
description: Node.js/TypeScript demo marketplace app for MoySklad

scripts.format: prettier --write package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.test.json docker-compose.yml README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md backend/src frontend/src tests
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.test.json docker-compose.yml README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md backend/src frontend/src tests
scripts.build: tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json && npm run frontend:build && npm run build:assets
scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p dist && rm -rf dist/frontend && cp -R frontend/dist dist/frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:test && npm test
scripts.clean:data: rimraf tmp/data && shx mkdir -p tmp/data && shx chmod 700 tmp/data
